title: "Not" is Not Lost in Translation: A Causal Analysis of Negation Representations in Multilingual LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.32281v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Negation occurs in every language, yet its surface realization differs drastically. Despite this, multilingual large language models (LLMs) translate negation robustly, raising the question of whether they share an underlying representation of negation across languages. We study this question in six open models across English, French, Vietnamese, and Chinese, using causal interventions on a synthetic contrastive dataset and a negation translation dataset derived from FLORES-200. Across models, we find strong evidence that negation representations are causally controllable and largely shared across languages. In particular, we show that a contrastive activation direction extracted from one language can induce or remove negation in the others, and directions extracted from different languages are substantially aligned. We further find that negation is represented in sparse features: a single sparse autoencoder (SAE) feature per model suf

translated_title: “Not”在翻译中并未丢失：多语言大语言模型中否定表征的因果分析
translated_abstract: 否定存在于每一种语言中，但其表层实现方式差异巨大。尽管如此，多语言大语言模型（LLMs）仍能稳健地翻译否定，这引出了一个值得探究的问题：它们是否在不同语言间共享某种底层的否定表征。我们在六个开源模型中，针对英语、法语、越南语和中文，通过在一个合成对比数据集以及从FLORES-200衍生的否定翻译数据集上进行因果干预来研究这一问题。在所有模型中，我们发现了强有力的证据，表明否定表征是因果可控的，并且在各语言间基本共享。特别地，我们展示了从一种语言提取的对比激活方向可以在其他语言中诱导或移除否定，且从不同语言提取的方向在实质上是相互对齐的。我们进一步发现，否定是以稀疏特征的形式表示的：每个模型中单个稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征即足以……
tldr: 研究发现多语言大模型在各语言间共享可因果干预的否定表征，从一种语言提取的否定激活方向可以在其他语言中诱导或移除否定，且否定由稀疏特征表示。
en_tdlr: Multilingual LLMs share causally controllable negation representations across languages—a contrastive activation direction extracted from one language can induce or remove negation in others, with negation encoded in sparse features.
